concepts.name: Янтарная зима
concepts.desc: One thick winter wool scarf, creamy ivory chunky ribbed knit with narrow muted coral edge binding. Cozy single neck loop of about 0.40m inside diameter. Two broad rounded-rectangle ends drape DOWN THE FRONT, left end 0.45m and right end 0.60m below the loop, visibly different lengths. Each end is about 0.15m wide and 0.03m thick, softly bent and heavy, no thin fringes. A small elegant round warm brass radio-coil clasp joins the ends at front center just below the neck opening. The knit reads as chunky continuous sculpted ribs, not detached strands. Distinctive high-end handmade winter accessory, tangible warm wool.

concepts.name: Облачный флис
concepts.desc: One plush winter infinity cowl scarf, a thick pearl-ivory fleece ring around a clear 0.40m neck opening. A softly rolled upper lip and lower lip form one continuous cozy neck loop. NO dangling ends and NO knot. The outside is sculpted short-pile plush in broad soft cloudlike fleece tufts, with opaque icy-blue binding along the bottom edge. One small flattened brass crescent clasp centered at the front, attached flush to fabric, no dangling parts. Thick fluffy volume must be actual solid surface not hair strands. A little asymmetric fold at wearer's left makes the design natural, but it is one closed hollow cowl. Premium warm cuddly fleece.

concepts.name: Комета сигнала
concepts.desc: One navy-blue and teal satin scarf with a compact hollow neck loop, inside diameter 0.40m, band width about 0.13m, solid fabric thickness 0.025m. One SINGLE long broad trailing ribbon tail, about 1.0 metre from knot to tip, i.e. 2.5 times the neck opening diameter. The single tail attaches at the REAR-RIGHT side of the loop, sweeps smoothly backward then down in a relaxed broad S curve, with a slight offset toward wearer's left so the full tail remains readable in front projection. No second tail. Navy satin body with restrained teal edge piping and a teal final quarter of the tail; a very small flush brass ring seam at the tail root. The tail is smooth opaque solid satin, round tip, no fringes, no translucent cloth. It must look like an elegant long wind-responsive scarf suitable for a later 5-bone trailing animation. Show entire long tail and entire loop, generous framing.

concepts.name: Северное сияние
concepts.desc: One elegant lavender and mint satin wrap scarf, opaque softly pearlescent cloth rather than transparent. Hollow neck loop with inside diameter 0.40m, two broad flowing tails. The lavender main loop has a mint inner facing and thin warm gold stitched edge. Two unequal tails emerge together from a loose knot at FRONT CENTER: the short 0.35m tail hangs toward wearer's right, and the long 0.65m tail curves gently down toward wearer's left in an S bend. Each tail is 0.14m wide, 0.025m thick, rounded at the tip. Broad smooth sculpted folds, no loose strands or fringes. One small attached flat brass radio-wave clasp sits flush over the knot. Dreamy but practical premium animated-game accessory. Keep all surfaces solid and physically understandable.

concepts.name: Праздничный эфир
concepts.desc: One playful but premium padded-knit patchwork scarf. Hollow neck loop, inside diameter 0.40m, with broad solid knit panels alternating muted coral, turquoise and warm cream, joined by large clean gold-colored stitches. One attached simple brass round signal button at front center. TWO short broad ends drape down the FRONT, each about 0.32m long and 0.15m wide, the left end mainly coral and the right end mainly turquoise, both cream tip panels. Each tip has THREE broad thick rounded fringe tabs integrated into the cloth, not strings, each about 0.045m wide and 0.07m long. The neck loop's back continues the same patchwork panel order. Substantial 0.025m cloth thickness, slightly pillowy padded volume, readable construction, balanced restrained colors, joyful original musical festival accessory.
